items.title: Lonnie Walker IV, Nuggets Agree To One-Year, $3.3M Deal
items.content:
The Denver Nuggets signed Lonnie Walker IV to a one-year, $3.3 million deal, his agent George S. Langberg of GSL Sports Group told Shams Charania of ESPN.

Walker averaged 15.2 points and 2.5 rebounds for Maccabi Tel Aviv last season.

Walker last played in the NBA for the Sixers during the 2024-25 season, averaging 12.4 points.

The Nuggets have now added Walker, Alpha Diallo, and Marvin Bagley III this offseason.

items.title: Nuggets Discussing Peyton Watson Sign-And-Trade Deals With Cavs, Bucks, Clippers
items.content:
The Denver Nuggets are discussing possible sign-and-trade deals involving Peyton Watson with multiple teams, according to Shams Charania of ESPN.

The Cavs, Bucks, and Clippers are reportedly interested in landing Watson.

Watson could still return to the Nuggets on a one-year, $6.5 million qualifying offer.

The Nuggets, who are currently the only team in the NBA in the second apron, signed Lonnie Walker to a one-year deal on Wednesday.

items.title: Rockets Waive JD Davison
items.content:
The Houston Rockets waived JD Davison on Wednesday.

Davison averaged 7.8 minutes in 28 games while on a Two-Way deal with the Rockets last season.

The 23-year-old was named the G League MVP while with the Maine Celtics during the 2024-25 season. 

The Rockets now have 14 players on their roster, with 12 players on fully guaranteed deals.

items.title: Clippers Waive Sean Pedulla
items.content:
The Los Angeles Clippers are waiving Sean Pedulla, sources told Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.

Pedulla was on a Two-Way contract.

Pedulla was named the G League Rookie of the Year last season, averaging 23.6 points, 6.8 assists, and 5.1 rebounds per game.
